task.prompt:
Input roles: image 1 is the exact FRONT master. Image 2 is the matching RIGHT profile, included to lock the depth of the head, torso and outfit. Image 3 is the matching BACK view, included to lock garment construction and hair volume. Create the corresponding LEFT profile of this same adult character, preserving all three references as one consistent character turnaround.
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE image in a matched character turnaround set for image-to-3D reconstruction.
Input image role: exact FRONT master of this same character. Treat it as the identity, wardrobe, silhouette, proportions, pose, colors, materials and framing lock, not as a suggestion.
Render the SAME adult stylized 3D character as if rotating a camera around one unchanged physical model. Do not design a new character. Preserve face anatomy in profile, head-to-body ratio, hair volume and handedness, height, weight, garment lengths, folds, cuffs, patterns, accessories, colors, material texture and complete shoes.
Keep exactly the same standing shallow A-pose as the front master in 3D: arms relaxed slightly away from torso, elbows nearly straight, hands empty and fingers relaxed, feet planted with the same spacing. Change only camera azimuth, NOT the pose. In a true side view, far limbs may naturally overlap; do not move the arms or stagger the feet to reveal them. Head/neck remain upright, no independent head turn.
Single isolated FULL BODY, entire hair/hat to both complete shoe soles, exact orthographic camera, no perspective distortion. Portrait 1024x1536. Match the front master's crown height, overall character image scale, center position and shoe-sole baseline as closely as possible. Pure white seamless background with only a faint short contact shadow under shoes. Same even neutral studio lighting and cinematic animated-film render style, crisp facial, hair and clothing details, no blur.
No extra characters, no scene, no furniture, no props, no text, labels, watermarks, collage, grids or turnaround sheet. Never horizontally flip the front image and call it a different view.
The exact short, very stocky and round adult man in the front reference. Keep huge heavy rosy freckled cheeks, round red nose, low grumpy mouth, very thick dark angry brows and messy dark-brown spiky hair. Same broad arms, stout belly, short strong legs. Same brick-red textured knit jacket/cardigan with lapel-like collar and rolled sleeves, golden-ochre vest, ivory collar and small peppermint-print cream neck napkin/bib visible ONLY on his front chest, brown leather belt with gold front buckle, dark brown textured trousers and heavy reddish-brown shoes. Rear jacket is plain brick-red knitted continuation with ribbed hem; no front buttons, front napkin, candy symbol or belt buckle pasted onto back. Keep the abdomen's volume in side profile, do not make him thin.
CAMERA VIEW: strict LEFT SIDE profile, exactly 90 degrees from the front. The character's ANATOMICAL LEFT side faces the viewer. Nose, chest and shoe toes point toward the LEFT EDGE OF THE IMAGE. Only one profile eye and the near ear should be visible. Do not render a front-side three-quarter view or a rear three-quarter view. Torso, head, pelvis and feet all share this exact side orientation.
